rationale: Karpurapu brings hands-on AI and machine learning research experience from SJSU with computer vision and full-stack skills, while Dmitry is building production ML infrastructure focused on model compression and efficient deep learning deployment—a natural fit where research meets real-world systems. Dmitry's conviction that model compression enables practical AI applications directly complements Karpurapu's research interests, and both work in Python, creating immediate technical common ground to explore how to make ML models deployable at scale.
intro_message: Karpurapu himavanth, meet Dmitry Kozlov — he's optimizing ML models for production deployment with model compression and CUDA, and your research background in computer vision and ML could inform how efficient inference works in practice.
